title: MIRROR ME — credits and asset sources

entries.title: MIRROR ME — concept, story, house and sound
entries.creator: Skewernet; AI-assisted development with OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex
entries.license: Original project work; no separate asset-license grant
entries.changes: Original game direction, writing, L-shaped house, seamless threshold portal, seven-chapter progression, keepsake puzzles, wake room, funeral-radio geometry, authored props, interface and procedural animation. Layered blood, pools, bedding/shroud forms, knife and care-room evidence in src/revelation.mjs are original project geometry and canvas artwork. Ambience, footsteps, crawling, breaths, sob-like textures, knocks, mechanical sounds and music-box tones are authored Web Audio synthesis; no external sound or prop library. The separate intruder in src/demon.mjs adds an original asymmetric facial sculpt, marbled tissue and ruined-cloth shaders, and layered wet strand hair while reusing the credited MakeHuman base. Its finite nonverbal breath, throat and contact textures are synthesized by project code; no film monster, likeness, chant, sound recording or new external asset is included. The later bathroom-to-bed evidence trail, hall-photograph interaction and wounded funeral-room mother use original project geometry, surface shaders and animation on the credited human rig.

entries.title: Three.js 0.160.1 and addons
entries.creator: Three.js authors; copyright 2010–2023
entries.changes: Vendored locally for rendering, mirrors, glTF loading, skeletal posing, geometry and HDR decoding. License text retained in vendor/THREE-LICENSE.txt.

entries.title: Kokoro-82M v1.0 — synthetic dialogue
entries.creator: Kokoro / hexgrad; ONNX conversion and runtime by k2-fsa / sherpa-onnx; original dialogue by MIRROR ME
entries.license: Engine and model weights: Apache-2.0; dialogue: original project writing
entries.changes: Twenty-nine original takes synthesized offline: twenty-seven narrative/broken-word performances, one ambient kitchen weather bulletin and one finite fictional funeral news report. Mara and the glass: bf_emma; Mum: bf_isabella; both radio readers: bm_george. The first Mum call uses telephone bandwidth; the final Mum line uses clear full-range speech. The broken-word take uses scripted phrase spacing and restrained amplitude modulation; it is not a recorded human sob. Telephone/radio filtering, restrained glass echo, spatial playback and loudness/headroom mastering are project work. Only the weather loop has a padded quiet tail; the funeral report plays once. Supplied synthetic presets; no human actor performance or real-person voice clone is claimed.

entries.title: MakeHuman / MPFB — female base, morphology and game rig
entries.creator: MakeHuman Team — Data Collection AB, Joel Palmius and Jonas Hauquier
entries.changes: Adult female morphological blend at 1.74 m; helper removal, anatomical subdivision, resting pose and glTF export. MPFB mouth-opening expression added as a jaw morph; the CC0 inside-mouth texture is copied unmodified as inside-mouth-mask.jpg. The project adds distance-driven foot planting, measured-bind-axis limb solving, crawling/ceiling poses and anatomical horror deformation. The existing credited rig is also reused for the seated wake figures and covered adult hand in the revealed room; no new body or monster model is downloaded.

entries.title: MakeHuman — system skin, eyes, hair, clothing and shoes
entries.creator: MakeHuman Team — Data Collection AB, Joel Palmius and Jonas Hauquier
entries.changes: System skin, detailed eyes, bob hairstyle, brows, lashes, casual clothing and shoes03 black shoes fitted to the female character; chestnut hair tint, PBR tuning, authored blood/material variants and desaturated mourning clothes. The clothed mesh and skeleton are reused for crawling and distorted figures, seated mourners and the covered adult hand; those poses and variants are project-authored, not separately downloaded assets.

entries.title: Red Shirt with Black Jeans — costume material
entries.creator: Margaret Toigo
entries.changes: Material used on the refitted female blouse/jeans costume, with roughness and scene-lighting adjustments. Current official MakeHuman asset-pack listing identifies this material as CC0.

entries.title: Chair Damask Purplegold — wood PBR maps
entries.creator: Eric Chadwick (models and textures); © 2021 Wayfair
entries.changes: Only the tiling wood texture maps are used. Image files copied unmodified and renamed; runtime tint, repeat and original floorboard joins applied. No chair model is included.

entries.title: Fabric Pattern 07 — fabric PBR maps
entries.creator: Poly Haven (publisher)
entries.changes: Color, OpenGL normal and packed AO/roughness/metallic maps from the Godot demo-project mirror. Source images unmodified; repeat, channel interpretation and material tint configured in the game.

entries.title: St Fagans Interior — HDR environment
entries.creator: Poly Haven (publisher)
entries.changes: Unmodified 1k HDR from the pmndrs/drei-assets mirror, decoded and prefiltered for restrained indirect/specular interior reflections. It is not used as a visible background.

entries.title: Original house PBR surfaces
entries.creator: MIRROR ME — AI-assisted procedural artwork/code
entries.license: Original project work; no separate asset-license grant
entries.changes: Original wallpaper, plaster, panelling, tile, linen, concrete and rust generated at 1024 px. Separate albedo, tangent-space normal and roughness maps; no third-party image used as their source.

entries.title: Original generated family images, material atlases and wound decal
entries.creator: Created for MIRROR ME with OpenAI image generation
entries.license: Original project artwork; no third-party asset-license grant
entries.changes: Original AI-generated fictional family images and house material artwork. Current tactile atlas supplies wallpaper, plaster and painted-panel albedos through quadrant crops; framed photos sample the family atlas. The earlier house atlas remains recorded. Generated artwork, not photographic capture. The intruder's original RGBA torn-tissue decal was generated for this project and projected onto its facial sculpt. Its generation brief and exact output hash are recorded in assets/character/unkept-wound.json; no existing film face, likeness or wound asset is used.
